changes.summary: Resolve the registered PLE table's CUDA device address once per allocation and use it in both gathers; unregister memory if address resolution fails.
Use CACHE_BASE/tilelang for compiled kernels across native and container launchers, preserving explicit TILELANG_CACHE_DIR overrides.
Refresh the NVMe reader's source guard for the reviewed QSA and PLE source, retaining all required hook checks.
Print the Penny Royal release, source commit and local-modification marker at startup.

validation.cuda_symbol: Resolved cudaHostGetDevicePointer through the actual container PyTorch dependency handle, CUDA 13.0; no GPU used.
